items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Buildings-only policy: theft is not an insured peril (2.1, 3.1.4), and personal effects in a conveyance away from the insured location are not insured property (4.3(d),(f)). Same case as Case 35, where t was 0.
Journey and conveyance costs are not an insured cost (5.2.5, 7.1.8(d)), and there is no insured event anyway. Same as Case 35, t = 0.
